answers.core: The Materials/Shaders of Label3Ds are I think not possible to edit/assign (though I'm not sure).  It has to be in the engine?
answers.workaround: There is no easy workaround I know of.  On the discord people suggested using Label2Ds and managing their positions using inverse camera transformations, but this would be quite messy/inefficient.
